title: Let admins create coupon codes
description: First step towards discounts: a Coupon table and GET/POST /api/admin/coupons for admins to list and create codes with a percentage off. Codes are case-insensitive and each code can exist only once. Applying coupons to orders comes next. Includes the migration, tests and README entries.

comments.issue: Codes are kept unique only by this check-then-insert, with no unique constraint on `Coupon.code`, so two concurrent requests can both pass the check and create the same code twice, and later lookups by code become ambiguous. Add `@unique` to `code` (and handle the P2002 error).
